aluminum_melting_3.name: Melting of Aluminum - Level 3
aluminum_melting_3.description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by heating under NPT conditions using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state and report the average value in m²/s.
